TRAP_DISTRIBUTIONAL_the_trap_recurred_by: THIS IS THE FINDING OF THE BATCH. In plant_cell (C2) and plant_block (C3), sigma is built from e_1 AND FRESH RANDOMNESS ONLY, NEVER e_2. Under an e_1-independent e_2 the vector is exchangeable given e_1, so an e_2-independent sigma leaves the joint law EXACTLY UNCHANGED. C2 and C3 are therefore dependence-DESTROYING, bounded above by the dependence the source already has - they cannot create the deviation they are meant to certify power against. The archive measures that bound: the maximally destructive member DEP-CAL-C gives joint TV 0.023457 / 0.023241, the noise floor. The reviewer's own paired control through the driver's statistics_of, 40 replicates: C1 at rho=0.05 shifts CHI-16/CHI-64 by +7.33/+1.96 and at rho=1.0 by +10182/+2554, while C2 AT ITS TOP RUNG eps=0.25 shifts +0.21/+0.16 and C3 AT ITS TOP RUNG q=1.0 shifts +0.15/+0.19. The two-endpoint DIAG-DEP-RHO evidence is real but is ENTIRELY C1-FAMILY: it answers DESIGN-TRAP-1 for C1 and for nothing else.

If sigma permutes e_2 only within strata that REFINE the e_1 binning at resolution K, every row of N_K is a union of such strata and N_K is exactly invariant.
